name: Currency Field
description: Adds a field for currencies according to ISO 4217.
project_description:
A field type for currencies, following ISO 4217. Add it to any fieldable entity and editors pick a currency from a select list built from every code in the standard, instead of typing one into a plain text field and hoping.

The module is small and feature-complete. It does one thing, has no dependencies beyond Drupal core, and is maintained for fixes rather than new features. The complete ISO 4217 list is bundled as data in currencies.yml (alphabetic code, numeric code, currency name, issuing entity, minor unit, and any withdrawal date), so there is no API call and no external service to depend on.

The field stores a single string value in a varchar(255) column. A storage setting chooses which column labels and keys the select options, so a field can store alphabetic codes while showing full currency names, or store numeric codes for a system that expects them. Two procedural helpers, currency_field_currencies() and currency_field_currency_options(), expose the same data to other code. The data comes from the currency-codes dataset. Maintained by tbcs, supported by FivePaths.
